name: ge-corporate-income-tax
description: Profit tax (corporate income tax) in Georgia (the country, GE) for tax year 2026, under Chapter XIII of the Tax Code of Georgia. Covers who pays; the distributed-profit model, where a company pays 15% only when it pays dividends, spends money on things unrelated to its business, gives things away free, or exceeds the 1% entertainment cap; the 0.85 gross-up; the 20% annual-profit regime for banks, credit unions, microfinance organisations and loan providers; the international company 5% rate; key exemptions; the monthly return and payment by the 15th; withholding on dividends, interest and royalties (5%) and on other payments to non-residents (10%, or 15% to preferential tax countries); penalty interest of 0.05% a day and the late-filing and understatement fines. Trigger phrases: Georgia profit tax, Estonian model Georgia, distributed profit tax Georgia, 15% Georgia company tax, dividend tax Georgia LLC, rs.ge profit tax return. Out of scope: personal income tax (georgia-income-tax), VA
